```python
import pandas as pd
import narwhals as nw

df = nw.from_native(
    pd.DataFrame({
        "id": [1, 2, 3],
        "jan": [10, 20, 30],
        "feb": [11, 21, 31],
        "mar": [12, 22, 32],
    })
)

long_df = df.unpivot(
    on=["jan", "feb", "mar"],
    index=["id"],
    variable_name="month",
    value_name="sales",
)

print(long_df.to_native())
```
